content: Yinni Gusunɔ u Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, wee ɑ wɑ̃ɑ mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑn suunu sɔɔ. Bɑ nɔni mɔ ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kĩ bu kɑ yɑm wɑ. Bɑ swɑsu mɔ, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ ǹ kĩ bu kɑ ɡɑri nɔ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ bɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ sɔɔru koowo kpɑ ɑ se ɑ doonɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ben bɑɑwuren nɔni biru ɑ dɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑ ɡɑm. Sɔrɔkudo bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ bwese mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑ.
Yen biru Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn yɑ̃nu mɛnnɔ ɑ yɑrɑ wunɛn dirun di sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ɡbɑ̃ɑrɑ. Kpɑ ɑ yɑri wuu ɡen min di yokɑ ben bɑɑwuren nɔni biru nɡe wi bɑ yoru mwɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ ɡɑnɑ yɑbɑ ben nɔni biru ɑ wunɛn yɑ̃nu yɑrɑ min di.
U mɑɑ nɛɛ, ɑ yɑ̃ɑ ni sɔɔwo ben nɔni biru kpɑ ɑ kɑ nu yɑri wɔ̃kuru. Kpɑ ɑ tii wɔ̃ke kɑ yɑsɑ ɑ ku kɑ tem mɛ mɛɛri. Domi nɑ kĩwɑ ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ yĩreru Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Mɑ u kuɑ ye Yinni Gusunɔ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ. U yɑrɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ ɡbɑ̃ɑrɑ kɑ win sɔɔru nɡe wi bɑ yoru mwɑ. Yokɑ u dɑ u ɡbɑ̃rɑru yɑbɑ kɑ nɔmɑ u win yɑ̃ɑ ni suɑ u yɑrɑ wɔ̃kuru tɔmbun nɔni biru.
Buru buru Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ nùn ɡɑri kuɑ u nɛɛ,
Isirelibɑ, mɛm nɔɔ sɑri be, bɑ̀ n nun bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mbɑ ɑ mɔ̀ mi,
ɑ bu wisio ɑ nɛɛ, Isirelibɑn sunɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ mi, wiyɑ ye ɑ mɔ̀ yɑ kɑ yɑ̃, kɑ sere mɑɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi.
A sɑ̃ɑwɑ yĩreru te tɑ sɔ̃ɔsimɔ mɑ bɑ koo yoru dɑ tem ɡɑm. Yɑ koo mɑɑ koorɑ.
Sunɔ wi u wɑ̃ɑ ben suunu sɔɔ u koo win yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ wɔ̃kuru kpɑ u yɑri. Bɑ koo ɡbɑ̃rɑru yɑbɑwɑ bu kɑ yɑri min di. Kpɑ u tii wɔ̃ke u ku kɑ win tem wɑ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kon nùn yinɑ bɛriɑ kpɑ u wɔri ye sɔɔ. Kon kɑ nùn dɑ Bɑbilonin temɔ. Adɑmɑ u ǹ tem mɛ wɑsi. Miyɑ u koo ɡbi.
Win sinɑ ɑsɑkpɔbu kɑ win kɔ̃sobu kɑ win tɑbu kowobu be kpurowɑ kon yɑrinɑsiɑ kpɑ n de bu bu tɑkobi sɔkiri.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ, nɑ̀ n bu yɑrinɑsiɑ bwese tukunun suunu sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ kon de ɡɑbu bu kisirɑ tɑbun di kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔrun di kɑ bɑrɑrun di kpɑ bu wɑ bu kɑ ɡere kɔ̃sɑ ye bɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kuɑ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, kɑ nɑndɑbɑ kɑɑ wunɛn pɛ̃ɛ di kpɑ ɑ n diirimɔ ɑ n kɑ nim nɔrumɔ.

Kpɑ ɑ Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ ɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɛniwɑ nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ ɡeruɑ. Nɑ nɛɛ, be, Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bɑ koo ben dĩɑnu diwɑ kɑ bɛrum kpɑ bu nim nɔ kɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu. Domi ben tem mu kuɑ bɑnsu. Gɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ mi kpuro, nu koo kɑm kowɑ ben tɔn dɑm dɔrebun sɔ̃.
Wuu si su tɔmbu dɑbi su koo kowɑ bɑnsu, kpɑ tem mɛ kpuro mu kɑm ko. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔrɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ koo ɡiɑ mɑ nɛnɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yinni Gusunɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔn ɡɑri
yi koo koorɑ
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Esekiɛli sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ Isirelibɑ bɑ rɑ n mɔndu mɔ̀ bɑ n mɔ̀, wee tɔ̃rɑ dɛnyɑmɔ, ɑdɑmɑ kɑ̃si nin ɡɑrɑ kun koorɑmɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ kon de mɔn te, tu kpe. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ tu ɡerumɔ Isireliɔ. Adɑmɑ ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ, tɔ̃rɑ turuku mɔ̀. Kɑ̃si nin bɑɑtere tɑ koo koorɑwɑ.
Domi nin ɡɑru sɑri te tɑ koo kɑm ko. Nɛn ɡɑri ɡɛɛ mɑɑ sɑri yi bɑ ɡeruɑ bu kɑ bu nɔni wɔ̃ke Isireliɔ.
Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ, ye nɑ ɡeruɑ kon ye ko. Yɑ koo koorɑwɑ yɑ ǹ tɛɛmɔ. Be, mɛm nɔɔ sɑribɑ, kɑ ɡem ben nɔni birɑ kon de ɡɑri yi, yi koorɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ,
tɔnun bii, wee Isirelibɑ bɑ nɛɛ, kɑ̃si ni ɑ wɑ mi, nu ǹ koorɑmɔ tɛ̃. Nu koo koorɑwɑ sere sɑɑ ɡɑɑ. Yen sɔ̃, ɑ bu sɔ̃ɔwɔ ɑ nɛɛ,
nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ nɑ nɛɛ, ɡɑri yi nɑ ɡeruɑ kpuro yi koo koorɑwɑ tɛ̃, yɑ ǹ tɛɛmɔ.
